property_summary: For every call to transfer, the reference contract always reverts when the _tos array is empty (i.e. _tos.length == 0), whereas the mutant (which removes the require) will allow the call to succeed for some inputs—so the property is that calls with an empty _tos must revert on the reference but not necessarily on the mutant.
change_summary: Remove the require check so calls proceed even when _tos is empty; this changes observable behavior when transfer is called with empty _tos.
